name: Loud Seahorse 55
author: satyamchaudharydev
description: Light fuchsia button that glows on hover with a smooth transition.
howItWorks: On hover, text color changes from #fff to #000, transform becomes translate(-0.25rem,-0.25rem), background changes from #000 to #ff90e8.
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Loud Seahorse 55</title>
<style>
/* Loud Seahorse 55 by satyamchaudharydev — https://uiverse.io/satyamchaudharydev/loud-seahorse-55 */
.button {
  --bg: #000;
  --hover-bg: #ff90e8;
  --hover-text: #000;
  color: #fff;
  border: 1px solid var(--bg);
  border-radius: 4px;
  padding: 0.8em 2em;
  background: var(--bg);
  transition: 0.2s;
}

.button:hover {
  color: var(--hover-text);
  transform: translate(-0.25rem,-0.25rem);
  background: var(--hover-bg);
  box-shadow: 0.25rem 0.25rem var(--bg);
}

.button:active {
  transform: translate(0);
  box-shadow: none;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button class="button">
    Hover me :)
</button>

</body>
</html>
